delta.comment: Contract replanning (operator-directed, 2026-08-19): clause-to-carrier matrix corrected to be EXHAUSTIVE. C2 was missing github-pr-automation; C3 was missing both fix-ci and _ship.agent.md.tmpl despite 134.004-T authoring both C3 dispositions there. Consequence: the matrix as written would not have detected ANY of the three prior fix-cycle defects, because each lived on a surface not listed as a carrier of the clause it broke. Added a carrier-completeness guard tying the matrix to the tasks that author each clause. Scope split: this task keeps structural coverage (byte identity, checksums, presence matrix); the semantic regression suite moved to new sibling 134.012-T to stay within the 2-hour rule.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (P1.1, review of 1dad725a): carrier matrix corrected a second time and designated the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. C2 had omitted both authoritative workflow-policies.md.tmpl and circuit-breaker.instructions.md.tmpl (134.005-T criterion 6 states the C2 capture-before-close requirement); C3 had omitted circuit-breaker.instructions.md.tmpl (criterion 7 carries the H12 symmetric guard). Registry was listed inconsistently despite authoring all seven clauses - fixed with an explicit registry rule. Root cause: matrix was derived by reading carriers ad hoc rather than inverting the authoring set, and existed in three independently maintained copies (here, H11, 134.012-T). H11 and 134.012-T now reference this block instead of restating it. Verified by a complete inversion sweep over all 12 tasks for C2/C3/C5.
